NetworkEvents.Name: ospfVirtIfStateChange
NetworkEvents.Description: An ospfVirtIfStateChange trap signifies that there has been a change in the state of an OSPF virtual interface.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfTxRetransmit
NetworkEvents.Description: An ospfTxRetransmit trap signifies than an OSPF packet has been retransmitted on a non-virtual interface.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfVirtIfTxRetransmit
NetworkEvents.Description: An ospfVirtIfTxRetransmit trap signifies than an OSPF packet has been retransmitted on a virtual interface.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfOriginateLsa
NetworkEvents.Description: An ospfOriginateLsa trap signifies that a new LSA has been originated by this router.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfMaxAgeLsa
NetworkEvents.Description: An ospfMaxAgeLsa trap signifies that one of the LSAs in the router's link state database has aged to MaxAge.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfLsdbOverflow
NetworkEvents.Description: An ospfLsdbOverflow trap signifies that the number of LSAs in the router's link state database has exceeded ospfExtLsdbLimit.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfLsdbApproachingOverflow
NetworkEvents.Description: An ospfLsdbApproachingOverflow trap signifies that the number of LSAs in the database has exceeded 90% of the limit.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfIfStateChange
NetworkEvents.Description: An ospfIfStateChange trap signifies that there has been a change in the state of a non-virtual OSPF interface.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfNssaTranslatorStatusChange
NetworkEvents.Description: Indicates a change in the router's ability to translate OSPF type-7 LSAs into OSPF type-5 LSAs.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfRestartStatusChange
NetworkEvents.Description: Signifies that there has been a change in the graceful restart state for the router.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfNbrRestartHelperStatusChange
NetworkEvents.Description: Signifies a change in the graceful restart helper state for the neighbor.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfVirtNbrRestartHelperStatusChange
NetworkEvents.Description: Signifies a change in the graceful restart helper state for the virtual neighbor.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfVirtNbrStateChange
NetworkEvents.Description: Signifies that there has been a change in the state of an OSPF virtual neighbor.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfIfConfigError
NetworkEvents.Description: Signifies that a packet has been received on a non-virtual interface with conflicting configuration parameters.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfVirtIfConfigError
NetworkEvents.Description: Signifies that a packet has been received on a virtual interface with conflicting configuration parameters.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfIfAuthFailure
NetworkEvents.Description: Signifies an authentication key or type failure on a non-virtual OSPF interface.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfVirtIfAuthFailure
NetworkEvents.Description: Signifies an authentication key or type failure on a virtual OSPF interface.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfIfRxBadPacket
NetworkEvents.Description: Signifies that an unparsable OSPF packet has been received on a non-virtual interface.

NetworkEvents.Name: ospfVirtIfRxBadPacket
NetworkEvents.Description: Signifies that an unparsable OSPF packet has been received on a virtual interface.

NetworkEvents.Name: coldStart
NetworkEvents.Description: A coldStart trap signifies that the SNMP entity is reinitializing itself and that its configuration may have been altered.

NetworkEvents.Name: warmStart
NetworkEvents.Description: A warmStart trap signifies that the SNMP entity is reinitializing itself such that its configuration is unaltered.

NetworkEvents.Name: linkDown
NetworkEvents.Description: A linkDown trap signifies that the sending protocol entity recognizes that one of the communication links has fallen.

NetworkEvents.Name: linkUp
NetworkEvents.Description: A linkUp trap signifies that the sending protocol entity recognizes that one of the communication links has come up.

NetworkEvents.Name: authenticationFailure
NetworkEvents.Description: An authenticationFailure trap signifies that the SNMP entity has received a protocol message that is not properly authenticated.

NetworkEvents.Name: DuplexMismatch
NetworkEvents.Description: A duplex mismatch discovered on a network interface (e.g., half duplex vs full duplex conflict).

NetworkEvents.Name: ciscoSyslogMessageGenerated
NetworkEvents.Description: A Cisco proprietary trap generated when a new Syslog message is logged on the device.
